DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、今は忙しいだろうか？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 全然！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ちょうど暇だったところ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: そ、そうか

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生に直接アドバイスをもらいたいことがあってな

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: すまないが、シャーレに行ってもいいか？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: もちろん！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: いつでも歓迎だよ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……了解

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: すぐに向かう

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、私だ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 色々試したおかげで

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 自然なポーズが分かってきた気がする

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……ありがとう

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: この借りはいつか必ず返す

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: サオリの写真が撮れるならそれで……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ダメだ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、今は大丈夫だろうか

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: もちろん！どうしたの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: その……お願いがあって

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: すまない、先生のほかに頼める人が居ないんだ

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: それは期待しちゃうな！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: どんなこと？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: この間のモデル関連の話だ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今回はドレスを着て、ダンスする写真を撮りたいらしい

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: だが、私には経験がない

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 可能ならば、ダンスを教えて欲しいのだが

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 仰せのままに！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: それでは、今から送る住所に来てほしい

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 面倒をかける

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、無事帰り着いただろうか

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 突然だが

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: さっき撮影チームから連絡が来た

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ダンスのシーンがなくなったとのことだ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 大人の事情とやらで

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 企画が変更になったらしい

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: せっかく時間を作ってくれたのに申し訳ない

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 楽しかったから大丈夫！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ダンスの練習は、二人だけの思い出になったね！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: そ、そうだな……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: とにかく、今回も勉強になった

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: これもきっと何かの役に立つだろう

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: それでは

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: これからもよろしく頼む、先生

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今日、時間はあるだろうか

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: もちろん！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: サオリのための時間ならいくらでも！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: そうか

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: モデルのバイト代が入ったので

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今まで世話になった分お礼がしたい

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: こういう時は高級料理をふるまうと聞いた

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 私は普通のお店が好きだなあ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: そうなのか？しかし……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 大事なのは気持ちだから！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: そうか……分かった

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: では、先生がよく行く飲食街を教えてくれ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: そこで待っている

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: その……今日はすごく楽しかった

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 料理も素晴らしいものだった

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: お礼をしたかったのに

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: また世話になってしまったな

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: こちらこそ！気にしないで！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 次こそ私にお礼をさせてくれ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: それと、念のため言っておくが

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今日の写真は、絶対ほかの人に見せたらダメだぞ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 絶対に、だ

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 뭔가 많은 일이 있었던 것 같지만…….

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 덕분에 자연스러운 포즈에 대해 알게 되었다.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 염치없지만, 선생 외엔 부탁할 사람이 없어.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 이번엔 드레스를 입고 춤추는 모습을 찍자더군.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 뭔가 어른의 사정이 있는 것 같다.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 이걸로 사오리의 인사는 나만의 것이 됐네!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 아무튼 이번 일로 또 다른 사회 경험을 했어.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 사오리를 위한 일정은 항상 비어 있어!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그래서 그동안 신세 진 것에 대한 은혜를 갚고 싶은데.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 이럴 땐 비싼 식당에서 비싼 음식을 사주는 거라 들었어.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 난 비싼 음식보다 간단한 게 더 좋은데.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그럼, 선생이 평소에 자주 가는 식당 거리에서 만나지.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 아…… 그리고 혹시나 해서 또 강조한다만.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 오늘 찍은 사진, 절대로 다른 사람은 보여주면 안 된다.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei. Are you occupied at this moment?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: No! Not at all!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I happen to be super free!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: ...I see.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I require your advice.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I apologize in advance for the inconvenience, but may I pay you a visit at Schale?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Of course!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Consultations are always welcome!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: ...Understood.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'll be there soon then.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei. It's me.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: It was a whirlwind of activity...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Thanks to your tutelage, I have a better understanding of natural poses.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: The thing I am attempting to communicate is...thank you.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I will repay you.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: A photo of you will do.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Absolutely not!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei. Do you have a moment?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Always! What's going on?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Well... I have another request.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I apologize. You're the only one I can turn to.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Now I'm really getting pumped!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: What's it for?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: It's related to the modeling job. From last time.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: They requested to photograph me dancing in the dress.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: However, I don't know how to dance.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: So it would seem I require a dance teacher.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Me! I can do it! Right now!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: ...In that case, I apologize for asking you to travel so far,

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: but could you meet me at the address I sent to you, please?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei. Have you returned safely?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: It was a bit sudden,

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: but the filming team just reached out to me.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: ...Apparently, the dance shoot was cancelled.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: They had a sudden change of plans.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: The adults had some personal circumstances to handle.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I apologize. After you spent all that time helping me...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: No, no! I had a lot of fun!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Now Saori's curtsy is mine, and mine alone!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I-Is that so?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Well, it did serve as a new experience for me.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I suppose it'll help me in my endeavors moving forward.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Well, then.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'll continue to count on you, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Do you have time today?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Of course!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: My schedule is always open for you!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I see.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I received my paycheck for my part-time modeling work.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I was hoping to use it to repay you for all you've done.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I've heard that, in situations like this, I should buy you an expensive meal at an expensive restaurant.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Simple meals are best!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Hm, is that so? But...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: It's the thought that counts!!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: ...Understood.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: In that case, let us meet at that food street you frequent often, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'll see you soon.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I...I had a good time today.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: And your dish was very good.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I had hoped to treat you out today,

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: yet somehow, I ended up being the one who benefitted.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Not at all. I enjoyed it.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'll treat you properly next time.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Ah... And I would like to emphasize that you should not EVER

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: show anyone the photo from today.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Never.

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ครู ยุ่งอยู่หรือเปล่า?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ไม่ยุ่ง! ไม่เลยสักนิด!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: กำลังว่างอยู่พอดีเลย!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: งะ... งั้นสินะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ฉันอยากได้คำแนะนำจากครูน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ขอโทษนะ... ฉันขอแวะไปที่ชาเล่ต์
สักเดี๋ยวได้มั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ได้อยู่แล้ว!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: มาปรึกษาครูได้ตลอดเลย!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เข้าใจแล้ว...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: งั้นจะไปเดี๋ยวนี้ละ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ครู ฉันเองนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: มีเรื่องเกิดขึ้นมากมายเลย...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
แต่มันก็ทำให้ฉันได้เรียนรู้ท่าโพสที่เป็น
ธรรมชาติ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เพราะงั้นก็... ขอบคุณนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ไว้ฉันจะตอบแทนบุญคุณนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ครูขอเป็นรูปของซาโอริก็พอ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อันนั้นไม่ได้สิ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ครู พอจะมีเวลามั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: มีอยู่แล้ว! วันนี้มีเรื่องอะไรเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คือว่า... ฉันมีเรื่องจะขอร้องอีกแล้ว

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถึงมันจะน่าอาย แต่ฉันไม่มีใครให้ไป
ขอร้องแล้วน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: พูดแบบนี้ก็ยิ่งอยากรู้นะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: เป็นเรื่องอะไรงั้นเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เรื่องเกี่ยวกับการเป็นนางแบบ
ครั้งก่อนน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ครั้งนี้เป็นการถ่ายวิดีโอตอนฉันเต้นใน
ชุดเดรส

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: แต่ว่าฉันเต้นไม่เป็นน่ะสิ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฉันก็เลยอยากให้ใครมาสอน...
ครูพอไหวหรือเปล่า?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ไหวอยู่แล้ว!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ถ้างั้นก็...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ช่วยมาตามที่อยู่ที่ฉันส่งไปนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ครู กลับไปถึงหรือยัง?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: มันกะทันหันไปหน่อย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: แต่ทีมถ่ายทำเพิ่งติดต่อมา

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ทางนั้นบอกว่ายกเลิกฉากเต้นรำน่ะ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เหมือนว่าแพลนจะเปลี่ยนอย่าง
กะทันหันเลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ทางนั้นคงมีเหตุผลละนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ครูเสียเวลามาช่วยฉันไว้แท้ๆ
ขอโทษจริงๆ นะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ไม่เป็นไรเลย! มันก็สนุกดีนี่นา!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
งั้นครูคงเป็นคนเดียวที่ได้เห็น
การทักทายของซาโอริสินะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: งะ... งั้นเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
งานนี้ทำให้ฉันมีประสบการณ์ทางสังคม
ในรูปแบบอื่น

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
มันคงเป็นประโยชน์ในการใช้ชีวิตต่อไป
ของฉันด้วย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: งั้นก็

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ไว้ต่อไปก็รบกวนด้วยนะครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: วันนี้ติดงานอะไรหรือเปล่า?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ไม่ติดอยู่แล้ว!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ครูมีเวลาให้ซาโอริเสมอเลย!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: งั้นสินะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฉันได้ค่าจ้างงานนางแบบพาร์ทไทม์
มาแล้ว

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ก็เลยอยากตอบแทนที่ครูเคยช่วยฉัน
เอาไว้น่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ได้ยินว่าควรตอบแทนด้วยการซื้อ
อาหารแพงๆ ในร้านหรูๆ ให้

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ครูชอบอาหารง่ายๆ มากกว่า
อาหารแพงๆ นะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อืม... งั้นเหรอ? แต่ว่า...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: สิ่งสำคัญอยู่ที่ใจ ไม่ใช่ราคา!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อืม... เข้าใจแล้ว

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
งั้นไปเจอกันที่ถนนร้านอาหารที่ครูไป
บ่อยๆ แล้วกัน

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: แล้วฉันจะไปรอที่นั่นนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เอ่อ... วันนี้ฉันสนุกมากเลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อาหารที่ครูเลี้ยงก็อร่อยมาก

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: วันนี้ฉันจะไปตอบแทนบุญคุณแท้ๆ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: แต่ได้เป็นหนี้บุญคุณอีกแล้ว

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ไม่หรอก ครูต่างหากที่เป็นหนี้บุญคุณ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ครั้งหน้าจะตอบแทนให้อย่างดีเลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อ่า... ฉันขอย้ำอีกครั้ง

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: รูปที่ถ่ายวันนี้ ห้ามเอาให้คนอื่นดูนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ห้ามเด็ดขาดเลย

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 不好意思……我可以到夏萊坐坐嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 不過多虧老師，我瞭解到了什麼是自然的姿勢

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 所以……我想跟老師說聲謝謝

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 總有一天，我會報答這份人情的

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 我只要有沙織的照片就滿足了

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 那個……我又有件事想拜託老師

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 雖然很厚臉皮，但除了老師之外，我沒有其他人可以拜託了

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 聽你這樣一說，我反而更期待了！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 跟上次模特兒的工作有關

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 他們說這次要拍穿著禮服跳舞的畫面

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 需要有人教我……可以拜託老師嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 請老師到我傳給你的地址來吧

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 不過攝影團隊剛才傳來聯絡

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: ……說跳舞畫面的拍攝工作取消了

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 企劃好像突然發生了變動

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 可能是有什麼大人的考量吧

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 明明老師都特地撥時間幫忙了，真的很抱歉

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 這樣沙織的問候就只屬於我一個人了！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 總之，透過這次的事，我又累積了更多社會經驗

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 這對今後的生活也會有幫助吧

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 只要是為了沙織，我的行程隨時都可以空下來！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我收到之前模特兒打工的酬勞了

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 所以想報答老師這段時間對我的關照

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我曾聽說這種時候，通常會去高級餐廳請對方吃高級料理

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 跟昂貴的料理相比，我更喜歡簡單家常一點的

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 那麼，我們就約在老師常去的美食街吧

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我會在約定時間等老師來的

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 今天本來是我要好好報答老師才對

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 別這麼說，收到好處的是我才對

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 下次我一定會好好招待老師

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 啊……為了以防萬一，我再強調一次

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 今天拍的照片，絕對不能給其他人看哦
